title: Material3 date and time pickers; no future dates
findings_note: MainScreen.kt:728-741 (date typed as YYYY-MM-DD), :614-628 (reminder hour and minute as text)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** field validation messages and numeric keyboards (S14 builds those). This slice replaces only the date and time inputs.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Dates are typed as `YYYY-MM-DD` and reminder time as two free-text fields. Mistakes are easy and S14's validation would be awkward without real pickers.
- Future dates must not be pickable, because they inflate streaks.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `PickerConversionsTest`:
- `localDate to utc millis and back is identity in any default timezone` (run it with `TimeZone.setDefault` set to `Pacific/Kiritimati` and `Pacific/Pago_Pago`, restoring the original afterwards)
- `isSelectable allows today and earlier and rejects tomorrow`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `PickerConversions.kt`: `fun LocalDate.toPickerMillis(): Long = atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli()` and `fun Long.fromPickerMillis(): LocalDate = Instant.ofEpochMilli(this).atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()`. The date picker works in UTC, so never use the default zone. Add `fun isSelectable(utcMillis: Long, today: LocalDate): Boolean`.
2. Entry date: replace the text field with an `OutlinedButton` showing the date in `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)`. Tapping it opens a Material3 `DatePickerDialog` containing a `DatePicker(state)`, where `state = rememberDatePickerState(initialSelectedDateMillis = date.toPickerMillis(), selectableDates = object : SelectableDates { override fun isSelectableDate(utcTimeMillis: Long) = isSelectable(utcTimeMillis, today) })`. Add "Today" and "Yesterday" `FilterChip`s above the button. Opt in to `@ExperimentalMaterial3Api`.
3. Reminder time: a single `OutlinedButton` showing `LocalTime.of(h, m)` formatted with `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedTime(FormatStyle.SHORT)`. Tapping it opens an `AlertDialog` containing `TimePicker(state)`, where `state = rememberTimePickerState(h, m, is24Hour = DateFormat.is24HourFormat(context))`. On confirm, store `state.hour` and `state.minute` as ints.
4. Remove the hour and minute text fields and the `toIntOrNull() ?: 20` fallbacks. The editor now holds hour and minute as `Int`s.
5. The date and time pickers may still be marked `@ExperimentalMaterial3Api` in the Material3 version chosen in S53. That is acceptable: opt in. Do not change library versions here.
6. Under the reminder-day chips, show the helper text "No days selected means every day." (S18 moves it to resources). Today an empty selection silently means every day.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes.
- Manual: tomorrow cannot be selected, the Today and Yesterday chips work, and the reminder time shows in 12 or 24-hour form matching the system setting.
- Change the device timezone to a far-east zone and confirm the chosen date is the date shown.
